MESSAGE: What? No! Don't!
Kaibosh99 was right to call you idiots!
MWAAAH!
Oh Fredbear, I beg of you, please don't hurt me!
Wait, what?
Mmmm! Delicious! Thanks, Fredbear!
Hey, you know what's funny?
What?
The fact that all four of us are one sprite.
So?
So it always looks like I'm talking!
No it doesn't! It always looks like I'M talking!
No, me!
Hey, we should get this kid to kiss Fredbear!
Whoever said that, that's an amazing idea! That'll be hilarious! Count me in!
I said it, it's my amazing idea!
UM, EXCUSE ME, I think you'll find that it was MY idea!
Come on guys, let's give this little man a lift!
You may kiss the bride!
Ready? One, two...
What?! No! It was me! I was the one who came up with the idea of kissing you!
You see, Fredbear gets it. He knows that I was the one who thought of it!
No, me!
I've seen many kids in my life before.
But none of them...
...have ever been brave enough to get that close to me.
Whenever I get close to the children, they aways run away, scared.
I don't mean no harm; I just want to be friends.
So in honour of your bravery, here, take this... it's a chocolate bar.
Pfft, yeah right.
Idiots
